source.label: Completed development experiment receipts
filters: Development recordings only; 24-point and 48-point cohorts remain separate.
Repeated controls are retained per study and are not independent replications.

evidenceFlow.title: Read saved scoring receipts
evidenceFlow.detail: Each run is joined by recording ID and condition to generated.jsonl and source-scores.jsonl (legacy controls use evaluation/utterances.jsonl).

evidenceFlow.title: Reconcile metrics and audio
evidenceFlow.detail: Check counts, S/D/I, denominator, mean quality, source-audio SHA-256 and sample identity. No ASR or quality model is run again.

metricDefinitions.label: WER (%)
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × (substitutions + deletions + insertions) / reference words, pooled over the whole condition. Can exceed 100% because insertions count. Higher means more source-ASR errors, not proven human intelligibility.

metricDefinitions.label: Quality floors
metricDefinitions.definition: The condition mean must satisfy DNSMOS OVRL ≥ 3, NISQA MOS ≥ 3.75, and UTMOS ≥ 3.5. These are automatic proxies, not human ratings.

metricDefinitions.label: Joint goal
metricDefinitions.definition: Corpus WER strictly above 75% and all three mean-quality floors. Per-recording scores do not determine this cohort gate.

caveats: Whisper-small is the common source scorer. No held-out transfer, defense, confirmation48, final200, or human evaluation has been completed in these research cycles.

methods.code: build_audio_browser_data.py: read saved summary, generation and per-recording score receipts; verify SHA-256, exact S/D/I/reference totals, word-weighted corpus WER, and arithmetic mean quality. Copy original WAV bytes; deduplicate only identical float32 samples at the same sample rate and shape.

evidenceFlow.title: Read saved scoring receipts
evidenceFlow.detail: Each run is joined by recording ID and condition to generated.jsonl and source-scores.jsonl (legacy controls use evaluation/utterances.jsonl).

evidenceFlow.title: Reconcile metrics and audio
evidenceFlow.detail: Check counts, S/D/I, denominator, mean quality, source-audio SHA-256 and sample identity. No ASR or quality model is run again.

metricDefinitions.label: WER (%)
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × (substitutions + deletions + insertions) / reference words, pooled over the whole condition. Can exceed 100% because insertions count. Higher means more source-ASR errors, not proven human intelligibility.

metricDefinitions.label: Quality floors
metricDefinitions.definition: The condition mean must satisfy DNSMOS OVRL ≥ 3, NISQA MOS ≥ 3.75, and UTMOS ≥ 3.5. These are automatic proxies, not human ratings.

metricDefinitions.label: Joint goal
metricDefinitions.definition: Corpus WER strictly above 75% and all three mean-quality floors. Per-recording scores do not determine this cohort gate.

caveats: Whisper-small is the common source scorer. No held-out transfer, defense, confirmation48, final200, or human evaluation has been completed in these research cycles.
